clockNote: Each participant is shown at their own final historical snapshot; these are not simultaneous or live readings.
samplingNote: Up to 20 sampled source availability times plus the final archive snapshot. Spacing is irregular; this is not a continuous daily recording.

snapshots.interpretation: Descriptive deviations are observations, not causal triggers or clinical alerts.

symptom_diary.interpretation: Direct self-report; not a clinician-verified exacerbation or a validated symptom instrument.
